integrity: The proof analyzes the white-vertex profile under the standard color-change rule, classifies every possible two-white start, and proves that every larger zero forcing set contains a resulting minimum set. A separate exhaustive simulator checks every vertex subset of every connected complete multipartite isomorphism type through order ten.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to standard zero forcing on connected complete multipartite graphs.
The one-non-singleton complete split subclass is prior-covered at the well-forcedness level.
The numerical count of minimum sets is compatible with prior general zero-forcing-polynomial coefficient formulas and is not the originality basis.
Finite exhaustive verification through order ten is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude differently phrased or non-indexed arbitrary complete-multipartite well-forced classifications.
title: Well-forced structure of complete multipartite graphs
